name: Discord
description: Posts a readable line to a Discord channel when a scan or an enrichment pass finishes, when somebody presses play or stop, or when a Library changes.

fields.label: Discord webhook URL
fields.help: Channel Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy Webhook URL. Anyone holding it can post to the channel, so it is stored as a secret and never shown again.

fields.label: Message: scan finished
fields.help: Placeholders: {library} {kind} {count} {files} {scope} {at}. Leave empty to post nothing for this event.

fields.label: Message: playback started
fields.help: Placeholders: {title} {kind} {who} {device} {at}. {who} is a User's display name, or a linked server — never a person on the other side of a Link.

fields.label: Message: library changed
fields.help: Placeholders: {library} {kind} {at}. Off by default — this one fires often.

fields.label: Mention a role
fields.help: Prefix every message with a role ping. Off means no message from this plugin ever pings anybody, whatever a Title happens to be called.

fields.label: Role id
fields.help: The numeric id of the role to ping. Turn on Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click the role and Copy ID.
